question: How much are we paying Advocate Medical?
ground_truth: Unit-rate contract — no fixed total. Lake County pays based on actual usage per Exhibit A fee schedule. 10% penalty if results not returned within two weeks. Net 30 payment under Illinois Prompt Payment Act. Invoices more than 90 days after service are forfeited.
